arStrings.szText: "What is it you were ordered to do?"
I’m chasing a group of Azmodan cultists who captured a girl known for her connection to the Light. Some say she has a gift of healing.
We were asked by her aunt to find her and offer protection but I was too late. They left with her shouting about a Forsaken Chapel... I have a feeling we’ll find something there.
Not rushing, but not taking your time to deliver the lines.
